verdict.rationale: Mollie documents accepting payments in currencies beyond EUR via its v2 APIs [mollie-docs-12], and provides Settlement Reports and Balances API for reconciling payouts [mollie-docs-10, mollie-docs-27, mollie-docs-11, mollie-docs-28], which supports part of the founder's need. However, there is no evidence detailing FX conversion rates, markup/fee transparency, or explicit confirmation that funds settle to the merchant's bank account in their own currency after conversion. Missing for 10: explicit FX rate/markup disclosure, settlement-currency selection/conversion mechanics, and independent confirmation of how multi-currency payments reconcile to a single bank currency.
